subject: design/acquisition-trust-v1
statement: A tool binary is verified against its manifest pin **when it is fetched** — streamed to a temp file, hashed in flight, chmod 0755, atomically renamed. A version-named cache entry that is already present is **trusted and executed as-is**, without re-hashing, on every later invocation.
